passplan 1
file "<root>/Outline/Fixed Color/outline pink.fx"
device HAL backbuffer=1000x600 format=A8R8G8B8 depthstencil=D24S8 vs=3.0 ps=3.0 mipfilter=1
load ok
effect scriptclass=0 scriptorder=0 posteffect=0 drawsgeometry=0 errors=0
parameters 4
param "matView" "VIEW" matrix_rows float 4x4
param "matWorld" "WORLD" matrix_rows float 4x4
param "matWorldView" "WORLDVIEW" matrix_rows float 4x4
param "matWorldViewProject" "WORLDVIEWPROJECTION" matrix_rows float 4x4
resources 0
controls 0
technique_order "EdgeTec" "MainTecSS" "MainTec0" "ZplotTec" "ShadowTech"
techniques 5
technique "EdgeTec" mmdpass=edge usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=0 passes=1
  pass 0 "DrawEdgeLine" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "MainTecSS" mmdpass=object_ss usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=0 passes=1
  pass 0 "DrawObject" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "MainTec0" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ZplotTec" mmdpass=zplot usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ShadowTech" mmdpass=shadow usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
selection subsets=2 clamped=0
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0"
  select object_ss 0-1 "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS" "MainTecSS"
  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTech"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
runs
  run "EdgeTec"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "DrawEdgeLine" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
  run "MainTecSS"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "DrawObject" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
enginelog "Loading effect file: <root>/Outline/Fixed Color/outline pink.fx"
end
